discordPostHtml:
A cute little pack of really neatly-sprited ships, most of them asymmetrical. That's about it.

With permission from ArbuzBudesh, this is now updated to 0.98, all ships spawn and have variants, and have sim/title/indevo entries

Doesn't have any requirements I think. Changelog in the folder. If I forgot the version just force compat.

I encourage yelling at me about balance issues- but if you want to burn me at the stake about it, I insist on pine wood.
